title: crocus hadriaticus subsp. parnassicus
intro: Crocus hadriaticus subsp. parnassicus, commonly known as Parnassian crocus, is a species of flowering plant in the iris family. It is a bulbous perennial that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Parnassian crocus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
